info.title: Octo Fleet Public API
info.description:
Stable Fleet API for tasks, experts, expert teams, executions, and
workspace automation.

get.description: Read the Octo Project member list using a User Bot's authorized owner delegation. The Loop workspace ID is the Octo Project ID. Pass it positionally or with --workspace-id, together with --space-id and explicit --obo. Requires a bf_ credential and a valid owner delegation grant. Returns items containing Octo uid, name, role and robot, plus total, limit, offset and decision_id. Use limit/offset pagination. Member listings include both people and Bot seats.

parameters.name: workspace_id
parameters.description: Octo Project UUID, shared with the Loop workspace identity.

parameters.name: space_id
parameters.description: Octo Space containing the Project. Required as a query parameter even when the profile has a Space configured.

parameters.name: obo
parameters.description: Explicitly request the Bot owner's authorized delegation. The server selects and verifies the owner; callers cannot supply a human UID.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of members to skip. Advance by limit to read the next page while offset is below total.

200.description: Octo Project members and offset pagination metadata.

uid.description: Opaque, case-sensitive Octo user UID. Use assignee_octo_uid when assigning a human Project member.

role.description: Project role: 0 common member, 1 admin, 2 owner.

robot.description: 0 for a person, 1 for a Bot. Bot seats remain visible in member listings.

TaskStatus.name: status
TaskStatus.description: One status or a comma-separated status union. The plural statuses parameter takes precedence when non-empty.

TaskStatuses.name: statuses
TaskStatuses.description: Comma-separated status union; when non-empty this takes precedence over status.

TaskPriority.name: priority
TaskPriority.description: One priority or a comma-separated priority union. The plural priorities parameter takes precedence when non-empty.

TaskPriorities.name: priorities
TaskPriorities.description: Comma-separated priority union; when non-empty this takes precedence over priority.

TaskAssigneeTypes.name: assignee_types
TaskAssigneeTypes.description: Comma-separated assignee actor types: member, expert, or expert_team.

TaskAssigneeID.name: assignee_id
TaskAssigneeID.description: Include tasks assigned to this Fleet actor UUID.

TaskAssigneeIDs.name: assignee_ids
TaskAssigneeIDs.description: Comma-separated Fleet actor UUIDs; matching assignees form a union.

TaskAssigneeOctoUID.name: assignee_octo_uid
TaskAssigneeOctoUID.description: Exact member Octo UID. Mutually exclusive with assignee ID and Octo UID list filters.

TaskAssigneeOctoUIDs.name: assignee_octo_uids
TaskAssigneeOctoUIDs.description: Comma-separated exact member Octo UIDs, at most 100. Mutually exclusive with assignee ID and single Octo UID filters.

TaskAssigneeFilters.name: assignee_filters
TaskAssigneeFilters.description: Comma-separated typed assignees in public form <member|expert|expert_team>:<UUID>.

TaskCreatorID.name: creator_id
TaskCreatorID.description: Include tasks created by this Fleet actor UUID.

TaskCreatorIDs.name: creator_ids
TaskCreatorIDs.description: Comma-separated Fleet actor UUIDs; matching creators form a union.

TaskCreatorOctoUID.name: creator_octo_uid
TaskCreatorOctoUID.description: Exact creator member Octo UID. Mutually exclusive with creator ID and Octo UID list filters.

TaskCreatorOctoUIDs.name: creator_octo_uids
TaskCreatorOctoUIDs.description: Comma-separated exact creator member Octo UIDs, at most 100. Mutually exclusive with creator ID and single Octo UID filters.

TaskCreatorFilters.name: creator_filters
TaskCreatorFilters.description: Comma-separated typed creators in public form <member|expert|expert_team>:<UUID>.

TaskLabelIDs.name: label_ids
TaskLabelIDs.description: Comma-separated label UUIDs; tasks with any selected label match.

TaskIncludeNoAssignee.name: include_no_assignee
TaskIncludeNoAssignee.description: Include unassigned tasks in the assignee filter.

TaskInvolvesUserID.name: involves_user_id
TaskInvolvesUserID.description: Filter to tasks involving this workspace user through an expert or expert-team assignment.

TaskMetadata.name: metadata
TaskMetadata.description: Flat JSON object of metadata key/value primitives used for containment matching.

TaskDateField.name: date_field
TaskDateField.description: Timestamp field selected by the date range; supply with date_start and date_end.

TaskDateStart.name: date_start
TaskDateStart.description: Inclusive RFC3339 timestamp starting the selected date range; supply all three date filters together.

TaskDateEnd.name: date_end
TaskDateEnd.description: Exclusive RFC3339 timestamp ending the selected date range; supply all three date filters together.

TaskOpenOnly.name: open_only
TaskOpenOnly.description: When true, exclude tasks in done or cancelled status.

TaskScheduled.name: scheduled
TaskScheduled.description: When true, include only tasks with a start date or due date.

TaskSort.name: sort
TaskSort.description: Sort tasks by position, title, created_at, start_date, due_date, or priority; defaults to position.

TaskDirection.name: direction
TaskDirection.description: Sort direction asc or desc (case-insensitive); ignored for position sorting.

TaskGroupBy.name: group_by
TaskGroupBy.description: Grouping dimension; only assignee is supported and is the default.

TaskGroupAssigneeType.name: group_assignee_type
TaskGroupAssigneeType.description: Restrict groups to none (unassigned) or one public actor type: member, expert, or expert_team.

TaskGroupAssigneeID.name: group_assignee_id
TaskGroupAssigneeID.description: Assignee UUID required with group_assignee_type member, expert, or expert_team; omit when the type is none.

MetadataID.name: metadata_id
MetadataID.description: Metadata key encoded as a path identifier.

WorkspaceIDHeader.name: X-Workspace-ID
WorkspaceIDHeader.description: Workspace UUID for workspace-scoped Loop requests.

runtime_id.description: Compatibility runtime selector. Prefer runtime_ref from runtime.list.

RuntimeCollection.description: Paginated logical runtime collection returned successfully.

Empty.description: Operation completed with no resource payload.

ValidationError.description: VALIDATION_ERROR — request fields or pagination are invalid.

Unauthorized.description: AUTH_REQUIRED — credentials are absent or invalid.

Forbidden.description: FORBIDDEN — principal lacks the required action.

Conflict.description: CONFLICT — runtime reference resolves to multiple workspace instances.

NotFound.description: NOT_FOUND — requested workspace resource does not exist.

RateLimited.description: RATE_LIMITED — request rate exceeded the configured limit.

InternalError.description: INTERNAL_ERROR — Fleet could not complete the operation.
